turns.text: Hi, can you tell me when my order will arrive? It is still being made, I think.

Please share your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address used for the order so I can check its status. Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries.

rule.ro: Livrarea durează 1–2 zile lucrătoare în România și 5–8 zile lucrătoare în celelalte țări din Uniunea Europeană.
rule.en: Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries.

turns.text: The order is SC-3188 and the email is helen.crowe@example.com. It ships to Berlin.
Your order is still in production. Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days, and delivery to Germany takes 5 to 8 working days. I can’t give an exact arrival date.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.
